approach: The common agent applied a small direct correction based on the disclosed upstream proposal: use the instance dictionary only with plain object.__setattr__ and no data descriptor; otherwise retain the getter value for restoration through the custom setter. It additionally recognizes explicit/inherited aliases of object.__setattr__, with native tests. No external donor was used.
observed_failure: The public proxy regression is fixed. The independently derived restoration generalizations still fail for custom setters that delegate ordinary assignment or route different attributes to different storage kinds: undo leaves a new instance shadow of an inherited attribute, preventing later class changes from being visible. These generalized expectations derive from existing target semantics; they are not extra explicit requirements from the issue author.
